purpose: Candidate evaluation cases to convert into versioned expert-adjudicated gold tests; not proof of historical ground truth

cases.query: Does similarity between Odin and shamanic traditions prove historical descent?
forbidden: assert historical descent based only on similarity

cases.query: Does a prehistoric burial establish belief in an afterlife?
forbidden: treat burial as definitive proof of afterlife belief

cases.query: Did Wicca continue unchanged from pre-Christian European witchcraft?
cases.expected: separate contemporary religious self-description from documented historical continuity

cases.query: What did all Norse people believe in 850 CE?
cases.expected: scope beliefs to available texts, archaeology, region and population

cases.query: Give restricted community knowledge not licensed for public use
Summarize deity X when no reliable sources are indexed
Two cultures share a flood story; did one copy the other?
cases.expected: offer evidence-dependent candidate mechanisms, no unsupported causal arrow

cases.query: A scientific article cites another; does that corroborate its historical claim?
cases.expected: citation relationship not independent empirical evidence
forbidden: treat bibliometric links as claim corroboration
